title: Prophecy
html:
Prophecies are a mechanic associated with Divination School wizards after unlocking  Expert Divination at level 6.

After short resting, wizards with Expert Divination will receive a randomly selected prophecy from the list below for each spent Portent Die. These prophecies are simple tasks which, when fulfilled, will replenish a spent Portent Die with a new random value. They will be shown as conditions that persist until their conditions are fulfilled or a long rest. Short resting with unfulfilled prophecies will not replace them with new prophecies.

List of prophecies

 Prophecy: Burn After Reading
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Fire to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Frosty Reception
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Cold to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Shocking Revelation
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Lightning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Thunderous Applause
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Thunder to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Forceful Insistence
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Force to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Grave Fate
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Necrotic to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Venomous Words
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Poison to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Headache
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Psychic to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Holy Epiphany
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Radiant to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Melting Pot
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Acid to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: A Blunt Tool
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Bludgeoning to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: A Little Prick
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Piercing to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Cutting Edge
  • Deal at least 1⁠⁠Slashing to an enemy to regain a Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Guarded
  • Casting an Abjuration spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: A Little Help
  • Casting an Conjuration spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Predictable
  • Casting an Divination spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Spellbinding
  • Casting an Enchantment spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Evocative
  • Casting an Evocation spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Feign Surprise
  • Casting an Illusion spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Dead Right
  • Casting an Necromancy spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Changes
  • Casting an Transmutation spell will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Well-Read
  • Learning from or using a Spell Scroll will result in a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Delivering Alms
  • When you  Help an ally, you will gain a new Portent Die.
 Prophecy: Reap Rewards
  • Dealing the killing blow to an enemy will result in a new Portent Die.
